summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues in the 36-RAW PXD072522 annotation.

reviewer_context.context: Separate subagent reviewed the final SDRF against accession-scoped PRIDE records and the depositor UTF-16 metadata; did not edit the SDRF.

spec_compliance.evidence: All 36 rows have the same 22 SDRF fields; official parse_sdrf validation against ms-proteomics with OLS cache returned exit 0 and Everything seems to be fine.

ontology_integrity.evidence: Official OLS-cache validator accepted structured acquisition, instrument, cleavage and label values. Stegodon is conservatively represented as Mammalia in organism and preserved verbatim in taxonomic identification.

source_evidence.evidence: PXD072522 PRIDE project gives extraction, digestion, instrument and blank protocols. UTF-16 depositor metadata provides 36 per-injection filenames, materials, specimen identifiers, archaeological sites, taxonomic identifications and demineralization buffers.

file_mapping.evidence: Compared every depositor metadata row with corresponding SDRF data-file row: 36 exact matches, all unique. These equal the 36 unique PXD072522 RAW filenames in PRIDE file inventory; no missing or extra RAW.

design_consistency.evidence: Naxian rows use Exploris 480, Baxian rows Fusion Lumos; fauna, hominin and blank material assignments align with depositor metadata. Enamel and enamel blanks use unspecific cleavage; dentine and dentine blanks use Trypsin, matching respective source workflows. S1/S2 pairs are technical replicate 1/2 within distinct preparation-specific source names. Distinct extraction blanks have distinct source names and nominal numeric biological replicate 1 required by template.

omission_safety.evidence: No species is inferred beyond depositor taxonomic identification. Homo sp. uses Homo; Stegodon uses Mammalia in ontology-constrained organism field with Stegodon retained separately. Extraction blanks are not assigned an organism or tissue.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -s annotations/PXD072522.sdrf.tsv -t ms-proteomics --use_ols_cache_only exited 0 with Everything seems to be fine. SHA-256 of reviewed artifact verified.
